verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents creating and managing cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule, and has dedicated Cron Runs and Scheduled Runs docs pages. Overlap control is only implied: its general concurrency strategies (e.g. CANCEL_QUEUED_EXCEPT_NEWEST/OLDEST) could limit overlapping runs, but nothing ties them to cron schedules. Missing for 10: cron-specific overlap policies, pause/resume of schedules, visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cron behavior.
